title.en: Little Cyclone: The Story of a Grizzly Cub (Ernest Thompson Seton)

text.en: A young bear loses his mother and must face a strange new world alone.

Little Cyclone was a grizzly cub who earned his name from his wild, stormy ways. When his mother was shot, he and his brother became orphans. One of them escaped, but Cyclone was captured and sent to the Zoological Park in New York. Most newcomers are scared on their first day, but when the box was opened he stood up with courage.
The story shows courage and the bond between animals and their keepers. It also reminds us that wild animals suffer when their homes and families are disturbed by humans.
Practise using phrases from the story in sentences. Learn the words grizzly, cub, orphan, captor and courageously.
